Package com.example.moogerscouncil

Class IntakeAssessment

java.lang.Object
com.example.moogerscouncil.IntakeAssessment
public class IntakeAssessment extends Object
Represents a student's completed intake questionnaire. Stored in the Firestore intakeAssessments collection and used by IntakeMatcher to recommend counselors.

  • Constructor Details

    • IntakeAssessment

      public IntakeAssessment()
      Required empty constructor for Firestore.

    • IntakeAssessment

      public IntakeAssessment(String studentId, String primaryConcern, String duration, String supportType, String urgencyLevel, List<String> tags)
      Creates a complete intake assessment from quiz answers.
      Parameters:
      studentId - Firebase Auth UID of the student.
      primaryConcern - Main concern selected in the quiz.
      duration - Duration answer selected in the quiz.
      supportType - Preferred support type selected in the quiz.
      urgencyLevel - Normalized urgency level.
      tags - Recommended specialization tags for matching.
